details.summary: This is an excellent, highly appealing whole-food snack that perfectly balances the dietary needs of the target audience with just a few everyday ingredients. A minor culinary tweak to add the garlic powder after toasting rather than before will prevent the spices from burning and ensure a perfect result.

dimensions.feedback: The pairing of savory, herbaceous, and slightly salty toasted nuts with the sweet, crisp freshness of a pear is a classic, highly appetizing culinary combination.
All ingredients in the list are used in the instructions, and no unlisted ingredients appear in the steps.

The instructions are excellent: they provide a cooking time range, a prompt to check at the minimum time, specific sensory doneness cues (popping seeds, fragrance), and a crucial step to remove the nuts from the hot skillet immediately to prevent carryover burning.
The ingredients (almonds, olive oil, rosemary, fresh pear) align perfectly with a Mediterranean flavor profile and snacking style.

Tossing the nuts in garlic powder before toasting them for 4 to 6 minutes in a skillet risks burning the delicate garlic powder, which turns bitter quickly. Concrete fix: Toast the raw almonds and pepitas in the oil first, and toss them with the fresh rosemary, garlic powder, and salt immediately after removing them from the heat while they are still hot.
